asked.item: credits used for scheduling about 300 posts a month
credits used for using own photos
whether any credits are used in this case

verdict.reason: The help pages state that scheduling posts and uploading your own images do not use credits, which answers the customer's question about their use case.

steps.text: Scheduling or publishing posts does not use credits.
Uploading your own images or videos does not use credits.
Credits are only used for AI-generated images and videos.
